Today, April 13th, Trevor, WA6JAU went back to Kregor Peak to continue troubleshooting. He was able to get the receiver working again. While he did touch a couple of receiver tune-up parameters he’s not certain that this is the end of our problems. We will continue to monitor the receiver performance and see if we have any further problems.

—————————————————————————————————————-

AS OF APRIL 11TH-Earlier this week the 147.735 MHz repeater on Kregor Peak had a receiver failure. On Friday, April 10th Trevor, WA6JAU went to the repeater and tried to revive the repeater. His efforts collected a lot of data but the receiver still doesn’t work. Trevor pulled the receiver and will try a few other tests over the next few days.

At this time please use the Bald Peak repeater located in Orinda on 145.49 MHz (-600 KHz) or Highland Peak repeater located in San Ramon on 145.41 MHz (-600 KHz).

We will keep you advised as we learn more.
